notes: Lase from the map · precision or barrage

A ✛ Lase button joins Map, 3D and Drone. On the map it turns on the laser designator: tap a red-boxed target or any spot and the fire mission panel opens, with the lased point marked on the map. In 3D it works as before

Fire missions are called by type, not by unit: artillery, mortars and air each offer ◎ Precision or ▦ Barrage, and the nearest ready unit answers. Artillery precision is laser-guided Copperhead, or GPS Excalibur in bad weather once researched; a barrage is HE from up to two batteries. Mortars fire 2 adjusted rounds or a barrage from up to two sections. Aircraft drop a laser-guided bomb or GPS JDAM, or lay a string of bombs along the target
